gloss: bridge of the nose; nose ridge

definitions.gloss: bridge of the nose; nose ridge
definitions.explanation: The line running from between the eyes down to the tip of the nose. A key feature in descriptions of facial appearance, especially in discussions of beauty and cosmetics.

examples.japanese: {鼻筋|はなすじ}が{通|とお}っている。
examples.english: The nose bridge is straight and well-defined.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{鼻筋|はなすじ}の{通|とお}った{美人|びじん}だ。
examples.english: She is a beauty with a well-defined nose bridge.

examples.japanese: メイクで{鼻筋|はなすじ}にハイライトを{入|い}れると、{顔|かお}が{立体的|りったいてき}に{見|み}える。
examples.english: If you apply highlighter along the bridge of your nose, your face looks more three-dimensional.

notes:
Composed of {鼻|はな} (nose) + {筋|すじ} (line/ridge). A straight, well-defined nose bridge ({鼻筋|はなすじ}が{通|とお}っている) is considered an attractive facial feature in Japanese beauty standards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鼻筋|はなすじ}が{通|とお}っている: to have a straight/well-defined nose bridge
- {鼻筋|はなすじ}にハイライトを{入|い}れる: to apply highlighter along the nose bridge
- {高|たか}い{鼻筋|はなすじ}: a high nose bridge
- {鼻筋|はなすじ}がきれいだ: to have a beautiful nose line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鼻|はな}: nose — the overall feature
- {小鼻|こばな}: nostrils/nose wings — the flared sides of the nose
- {鼻先|はなさき}: tip of the nose — the very end
